map.输入目标转化量、预期CPC或转化成本，估算Google Ads搜索广告所需的投放: Enter target conversions and expected CPC or cost per conversion to estimate the budget and expected results for Google Ads search campaigns, supporting delivery planning.
map.按日均点击目标和 CPC 估算日/月预算。: Estimate daily and monthly budget from the target daily clicks and CPC.
map.由转化率和客单价估 ROAS 看投放值不值。: Estimate ROAS from conversion rate and order value to see whether the spend is worth it.
map.扩量前用模型先算增量预算产出。: Before scaling, use the model to estimate the output of incremental budget.
map.：平均 CPC=3、目标日点击 100 → 日预算=3×100=300 元，月预: : average CPC = 3, target 100 clicks a day -> daily budget = 3 x 100 = 300 CNY, monthly budget = 300 x 30 = 9,000 CNY; with daily revenue 1,200 -> ROAS = 1200/300 = 4.0x.
map.：CPC 不变、日点击由 100 提到 200 → 月预算 18000，收入约: : with CPC unchanged and daily clicks rising from 100 to 200 -> monthly budget 18,000, revenue about 2400/day; if ROAS holds at 4.0x, scaling is viable.
map.ROAS 用到收入还是利润？: Does ROAS use revenue or profit?
map.本工具用广告收入算 ROAS，未扣货成本；真实盈利要再乘毛利率，平衡 ROAS=: This tool computes ROAS from ad revenue without deducting cost of goods; for real profit multiply by gross margin, and the break-even ROAS = 1 / gross margin.
map.日预算能直接×30 吗？: Can the daily budget just be multiplied by 30?
map.粗略可行，但周末/大促波动大，建议用近 30 天实际均值更准。: Roughly workable, but weekends and big promotions swing a lot, so a 30-day actual average is more accurate.
